rfft2.input: contiguous base MetalArray float32, rank 2 through 16, every extent positive

irfft2.input: contiguous base MetalArray complex64, rank 2 through 16, every extent positive
irfft2.output: float32 with trailing shape (ny, nx); odd nx is passed explicitly with s

execution.ownership: native submission retains plan, tensor data, dictionaries, buffers and execution descriptor until completion
execution.ordering_boundary: Python serializes all enqueue methods; graph submissions drain all prior submissions, and every later custom/fill/bookkeeping/acoustic submission waits for outstanding graph callbacks
execution.ordering_cost: graph/custom alternation synchronously waits for graph completion at each boundary; this is intentionally conservative and limits overlap until native queue ordering is proven

unsupported: nonzero MetalArray byte offsets or arbitrary strides
dtype conversions and non-float32/complex64 FFT arithmetic
resize or pad through rfft2 s; rfft2 s must match input's final two dimensions
irfft2 norms other than None or backward
axes other than the last two
bitwise identity with NumPy or CUDA
